stages.name: Set up
stages.notes: Three handlers, four cutters level across the field 15 yards ahead.

stages.name: Hit the under
stages.notes: C3 checks under into the lane C2 has cleared; H1 hits them.

stages.name: Go to space
stages.notes: C2 has kept going deep: C3 puts it into the space for the score.
